long_biography.plain_text:
Johan van der Werf oversaw Aegon's internal university and the development of its curriculum. The programme brought promising middle managers together for three weeks of study spread over two years. Participants spent two weeks in the United States and one in the Netherlands, building working relationships across the insurer's businesses.

His approach to the Dutch insurance operation also involved reorganising how work was done. Thirteen previously separate business units were to become five service centres and four marketing and sales organisations at three locations. The plan separated shared administrative processes from customer-facing work and specified that staff reductions would come through attrition rather than compulsory redundancies.
